name: Summer Playground Program (SPP)
description_short: An 8-week town summer day program at the Community Field playground, 9 am to 3:30 pm, for North Attleboro residents entering grades 1–6. A similar program (SPP2) is offered for residents entering grades 7–8.

warnings: This page is the town's overview of Parks & Recreation programs across all seasons, not a page for one camp. Other summer programs on it (Summer Sports Weeks, Zoo Crew, Junior Zoo Rangers, Instrumental Music Week, swim lessons) are not recorded here.
No season year, dates or prices appear anywhere on the page. The only year mentioned is 2012 (Robotics), so the content may be out of date.
Summer Playground Program is for North Attleboro residents only.
Registration timing is described only as 'usually' the first Saturday of April, running until full.
Extended hours are not guaranteed: 'if there is enough interest in extended hours, we have run them in the past.'
The 446 Elm Street (Mason Fieldhouse) address is the Parks & Recreation office, not the program site (Community Field playground), so it was not used as the camp address.
